name: Wren
about: Wren comes directly from the English name of the small songbird known for its lively call and compact form. As a modern nature name, it carries associations with birdsong, woodland and quiet natural beauty. Used across genders, Wren is a concise and contemporary gender-neutral name with a distinctly English character.

name: Waverly
about: Waverly developed from an English surname and place name traditionally interpreted as referring to a quivering or moving meadow. Its gentle sound and landscape association give it an airy, pastoral character. Used across genders, Waverly is a distinctive gender-neutral name that combines English heritage with modern appeal.

name: Wallis
about: Wallis is an English surname-derived given name related to the medieval term used for a Welsh person or, more broadly, someone from a foreign land. The surname has deep roots in British history and developed into occasional given-name use. Rare but established across genders, Wallis has a distinctive, understated character.

name: Whitney
about: Whitney comes from an English surname and place name meaning 'white island,' from Old English elements associated with white and island or river land. It became established as a given name and developed substantial usage across genders, particularly in the United States. Familiar yet distinctive, Whitney is a gender-neutral name with strong English and American associations.

name: Wendel
about: Wendel is a Germanic name found in rare Dutch, German and Brazilian Portuguese usage. It is connected with the historical name of the Vandals and with Germanic naming traditions associated with the Wendels. Used across genders in the documented traditions, Wendel is an uncommon gender-neutral name with an old European character.

name: Wil
about: Wil is an established short form used in English and Dutch for names such as William, Wilhelmina and other names beginning with Wil-. Its underlying Germanic elements are associated with will, desire and determination. Compact and familiar across several naming traditions, Wil works naturally as a concise gender-neutral name.

name: Wen
about: Wen is a Chinese given name whose meaning depends on the character used. 文 can relate to culture, writing, literature or pattern, while 雯 refers to decorative cloud formations in the sky. Used across genders, Wen is a compact Chinese name whose precise meaning should be understood through its written character.

name: Wei
about: Wei is a widely used Chinese given name whose meaning varies according to the character chosen. Characters used in names pronounced Wei can convey meanings including greatness, strength, valuable qualities or other positive attributes. Used across genders, Wei demonstrates why Chinese names are best understood through both their pronunciation and written character.

name: Wanangwa
about: Wanangwa is a Tumbuka name meaning 'freedom.' Its meaning expresses independence, liberty and the ability to live without restraint. Used across genders, Wanangwa brings a distinctive Tumbuka naming tradition into the collection and carries a powerful universal idea.

name: Willoughby
about: Willoughby comes from an English surname and place name traditionally interpreted as 'willow town,' combining the Old English words associated with willow and settlement. Its connection with willow trees gives it a natural softness alongside its historical surname character. Rare but used across genders, Willoughby is an unusual gender-neutral name with strong English roots.

name: Wai
about: Wai is a Burmese name associated with meanings including 'to distribute,' 'to be profuse' and 'to abound.' Its concise form makes it easy to use internationally while retaining a distinct Burmese cultural identity. Used across genders, Wai provides a compact and uncommon Southeast Asian option.

name: Wambli
about: Wambli is a Lakota name meaning 'eagle.' The eagle carries powerful associations with freedom, vision, strength and the natural world. Used across genders, Wambli brings Indigenous North American naming tradition and strong bird symbolism to the collection.

name: Wangchuk
about: Wangchuk is a Tibetan and Bhutanese name associated with the meaning 'mighty.' Its elements connect with ideas of power and wealth, giving it a strong and dignified character. Used across genders, Wangchuk provides distinctive Himalayan representation.

name: Wattana
about: Wattana is a Thai name associated with 'development,' 'prosperity' and 'growth.' Its positive meaning connects the name with progress, flourishing and personal development. Used across genders, Wattana adds a meaningful Thai option to the collection.

name: Wayan
about: Wayan is a Balinese name derived from a word meaning 'old' or 'mature.' In traditional Balinese naming, it is associated with the first-born child and forms part of a wider birth-order naming system. Used across genders, Wayan offers a strong connection to Balinese culture and heritage.

name: Wenting
about: Wenting is a Chinese given name whose precise meaning depends on the characters used. A common combination, 文婷, brings together 文, associated with culture, writing or literature, and 婷, associated with prettiness or grace. Other character combinations are possible, so the written form determines the exact meaning.

name: Wesam
about: Wesam is an Arabic name and alternate transcription of Wisam, meaning 'badge' or 'medal.' The meaning evokes honour, recognition and achievement. Used across genders, Wesam is a concise Arabic choice with a positive and distinguished association.

name: Whetū
about: Whetū is a Māori name meaning 'star.' Its celestial meaning gives it associations with the night sky, guidance and natural beauty. The macron in Whetū represents the long vowel in Māori pronunciation. Used across genders, Whetū brings a distinctive Māori nature name into the collection.

name: Willie
about: Willie is an English diminutive of William and related forms. The underlying Germanic elements are associated with will, desire and determination. Willie has established masculine and feminine use and provides a familiar, friendly gender-neutral option with deep English-language roots.

name: Wynne
about: Wynne is a Welsh and English name with more than one documented route. It can be associated with the Welsh name Wyn and also occurs as an English surname-derived given name. Used across genders, Wynne has a concise sound and strong Welsh heritage while remaining accessible internationally.
